content.user_title: Build Reliable React Native Zustand Stores
content.value_statement: React Native teams often lose time on stale state, async action timing, and avoidable renders. This skill provides Zustand patterns that make store behavior easier to reason about, test, and debug.
actual_capabilities: Explains how synchronous store updates interact with batched React renders.
Shows how to avoid stale closures with current store reads after async waits.
Compares async action patterns that callers can await and test.
Covers selector stability, shallow comparisons, and Zustand 5 migration notes.
Describes derived state, subscriptions, testing resets, and debugging with devtools.
Provides focused examples for React Native assessment or form state flows.
limitations: Does not install packages, run commands, or inspect a live project by itself.
Assumes the user already uses React Native and Zustand.
Examples are illustrative and need adaptation for each store shape.
Does not cover every middleware, persistence library, or server state tool.

use_cases.title: Fix Async Store Bugs
use_cases.description: A mobile developer can diagnose stale values after awaits and keep store actions awaitable.

use_cases.title: Review Store Architecture
use_cases.description: A lead engineer can compare selector and derived state choices before refactoring shared stores.

use_cases.title: Improve Test Coverage
use_cases.description: A QA-focused developer can plan reset helpers and assertions for async state flows.

prompt_templates.title: Explain Zustand Timing
prompt_templates.prompt: Explain why a Zustand store update can be synchronous while a React Native component still shows old state. Use simple examples.

prompt_templates.title: Fix Stale State
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my React Native Zustand action for stale closures after await. Suggest current-state reads and explain each change.

prompt_templates.title: Refactor Selectors
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess these selectors for avoidable re-renders. Recommend shallow comparison, separate selectors, or useShallow where appropriate.

prompt_templates.title: Design Store Test Strategy
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a test strategy for a complex Zustand store with async actions, reset helpers, subscriptions, and derived state. Include edge cases.

output_examples.input: A user asks why a saved answer is missing after an awaited operation.
output: Identifies a stale closure caused by reading captured component state after the wait.
Recommends reading current store state before writing the answer.
Explains why the component view may update after the store value changes.

output_examples.input: A user asks how to reduce rerenders from Zustand selectors.
output: Points out selectors that create new objects each render.
Suggests separate selectors or shallow comparison.
Notes the different shallow helper pattern for Zustand 4 and 5.

output_examples.input: A user asks how to test an async store action.
output_examples.output: Outlines initial state reset, awaited actions, and final state assertions without depending on component render timing.

best_practices: Read current store state after async waits when freshness matters.
Keep derived values computed from source state unless storage is required.
Use stable selectors to avoid unnecessary React Native renders.
anti_patterns: Assuming component state updates immediately after every store write.
Returning new selector objects on each render without shallow comparison.
Making async store actions unawaitable when callers need completion.

faq.question: Is this only for React Native?
faq.answer: The examples target React Native, but most Zustand timing and selector guidance also applies to React.

faq.question: Does it execute any commands?
faq.answer: No. The skill is documentation only and contains TypeScript examples for discussion.

faq.question: Can it migrate a Zustand 4 store to version 5?
faq.answer: It highlights shallow selector changes and type inference notes, but migrations still need project review.

faq.question: Does it replace server state tools?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on client store patterns, not query caching or server synchronization.

faq.question: Can it help with tests?
faq.answer: Yes. It describes reset helpers and async assertions for Zustand store tests.

faq.question: What problems does it diagnose best?
faq.answer: It is strongest for stale closures, batched render confusion, selector churn, derived state drift, and async action timing.
